Enveritas (YC S18, non-profit) | Backend Software Engineer | Remote (Global) | https://enveritas.org/jobs/ 
Enveritas is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit working on sustainability issues facing smallholder coffee farmers. We collect field data in 30+ countries and build systems for analyzing risks in coffee, cocoa, and tea supply chains (including EUDR-related deforestation checks). * Backend Software Engineer (Python, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Docker, AWS, Terraform) - $135-$155k - https://enveritas.org/jobs/backend-software-eng/#10d7adef8us (worldwide remote)
